description: The origins view prints one origins line per record, declaration and contribution of the inspect data stream, in the order the reader yields them, across an import; each line's data is the provenance envelope export writes beside that item: the node location, the source revisions its locations name, the shared origin table with literal, merge-derived and context-derived origins, and each field's origin; input.kdl and other.kdl are byte copies of processing/bind/stream so the source paths are scenario-relative
